answer: Each applicant gets a hand-blown violet glass vessel with random, unclonable internal geometry, a fingerprint no two share. The registry fires a fresh ping at it inside a quiet oasis chamber and records the returning echo decay as that identity's signature; every epoch a new ping comes and only that vessel's live echo passes. Each additional fake needs its own vessel: $175 to blow and calibrate, plus 40 minutes alone in the chamber, one vessel at a time. Five thousand fakes need 5,000 vessels, $875,000, 3,333 chamber-hours: no replays, no copied geometry, no wholesale glass.
